Sign up for The Daily Star Muktijuddho Olympiad now!
2021-02-01T12:27:47+06:00 | Youth Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-youth/news/sign-the-daily-star-muktijuddho-olympiad-now-2037337

Registration is open for The Daily Star Muktijuddho Olympiad – the largest Olympiad on the Liberation War. The event is a joint initiative by The Daily Star and efood.

Share your knowledge about the rich history of Bangladesh and our great Liberation War, and win exciting prizes!. Students belonging to any school, college or university can participate in the Olympiad. The last date of registration is February 20, 2021.

Register here: http://campaign.thedailystar.net/dsolympiad/
